tool.name: Zeiierman
tool.description: Zeiierman sells invite-only indicators and toolkits that run inside TradingView, including trend, liquidity and oscillator tools. The site says they work on TradingView's free plan.
features: Premium TradingView indicators. The site says the library is 80 or more
Toolkits covering trend, liquidity, oscillators and buy and sell signals
Access is tied to your TradingView username
Monthly, quarterly, yearly and lifetime options are described on the site
tool.pricing_note: The official site describes monthly, quarterly, yearly and lifetime plans, but no dollar amount was on the pages we could read on 11 Oct 2026.
